notes.id: Gelombang kedua memicu kolaps layanan pemakaman di kota-kota pesisir timur; penurunan angka harapan hidup nasional hingga 12 tahun.
notes.en: The second wave collapsed mortuary services in eastern cities; national life expectancy plummeted by 12 years.

notes.id: Vektor transmisi masif di barak Étaples, pelabuhan Brest, dan parit-parit Front Barat Perang Dunia I.
notes.en: Massive transmission vector across Étaples barracks, Brest ports, and Western Front trench warfare.

notes.id: Melumpuhkan pabrik amunisi dan kapal-kapal Grand Fleet di pangkalan laut Scapa Flow.
notes.en: Paralyzed munitions factories and Royal Navy battleships across the Scapa Flow anchorage.

notes.id: Karena netral dalam perang, pers Spanyol bebas memberitakan wabah tanpa sensor masa perang, mempopulerkan nama 'Flu Spanyol'.
notes.en: As a neutral state, Spanish press reported the epidemic without wartime censorship, coining the pandemic moniker.

notes.id: Dikenal sebagai 'Blitzkatarrh'; infeksi massal di barisan tentara melemahkan Serangan Musim Semi Jenderal Ludendorff.
notes.en: Known as 'Blitzkatarrh'; severe outbreaks among frontline troops blunted General Ludendorff's 1918 Spring Offensive.

notes.id: Kehilangan korban jiwa tertinggi di dunia; kekeringan dan kemiskinan kolonial memperparah kematian hingga sungai suci tersumbat jenazah.
notes.en: Highest national fatality toll globally; drought and colonial malnutrition compounded losses, choking holy rivers with bodies.

notes.id: Dikenal rakyat sebagai 'Pagebluk'; masuk lewat pelabuhan Surabaya dan Tanjung Priok, melenyapkan desa-desa tani di pedalaman Jawa dan Madura.
notes.en: Known locally as 'Pagebluk'; entered via Surabaya and Batavia harbors, decimating rural farming villages across Java and Madura.

notes.id: Membentang dari garis pertahanan Piave hingga desa-desa Mezzogiorno di selatan Italia.
notes.en: Struck the Piave defensive front lines and impoverished agrarian communes of the Mezzogiorno.

notes.id: Penyebaran flu berpadu dengan tifus bercak di tengah amukan Perang Saudara Rusia dan kekacauan jalur kereta api.
notes.en: Influenza converged lethally with epidemic typhus amidst Russian Civil War turmoil and disrupted railways.

notes.id: Kapal uap SS Demerara membawa gelombang ganas ke Rio de Janeiro dan São Paulo, bahkan merenggut nyawa Presiden terpilih Rodrigues Alves.
notes.en: The steamship Demerara sparked catastrophic urban surges in Rio and São Paulo, claiming the life of President-elect Rodrigues Alves.

notes.id: Dikenal sebagai 'Ryukan' (Flu Spanyol); penerapan pemakaian masker universal paling disiplin di dunia dipromosikan oleh polisi sanitasi.
notes.en: Known as 'Ryukan'; early widespread masking campaigns were rigorously enforced by national police hygiene authorities.

notes.id: Dikenal sebagai 'Black October'; pekerja tambang emas Witwatersrand dan komunitas pedesaan pribumi mengalami mortalitas sangat tinggi.
notes.en: Known as 'Black October'; devastated Witwatersrand gold miners and segregated native communities.

notes.id: Kapal SS Talune tiba tanpa pemeriksaan karantina ketat, melenyapkan lebih dari 20% populasi dalam tragedi kemanusiaan Pasifik paling mengerikan.
notes.en: SS Talune docked without quarantine, eradicating over a fifth of the island's population in the Pacific's deadliest tragedy.

notes.id: Tiba lewat kapal RMS Niagara; kematian populasi suku Māori tercatat tujuh kali lebih tinggi dibanding populasi Pākehā (Eropa).
notes.en: Arrived on the RMS Niagara; Māori indigenous mortality was seven times higher than that of European Pākehā.

notes.id: Penyebaran melalui koridor kereta api dan pelabuhan traktat, dengan dampak bervariasi di tengah fragmentasi politik faksi militer.
notes.en: Spread along treaty ports and railway lines amidst the political fragmentation of the Warlord Era.
